{{Top|leg}}
An '''ion pulse bomb''' was a weapon. When detonated, it temporarily neutralized all active electronic systems in a two-hundred-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius. [[Justice Action Network]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] used an ion pulse bomb too disrupt the [[Unification Gala]] and capture high-profile targets. The weapon was supplied to them by [[Trevas Jotane]], an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[operative]] posing as a [[House Calipsa]] [[Knight (noble rank)/Legends|knight]].<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
